import_processors_multimodal: import multimodal processors from a package and register them in the processor mapping
get_mm_processor_for_model: get the appropriate multimodal processor class for a given model architecture and server config
register_processor_in_mapping: register a multimodal processor class into the global PROCESSOR_MAPPING for a model architecture
create_transformers_auto_processor: create a fallback TransformersAutoMultimodalProcessor when no registered processor matches the model architecture
build_processor_with_backend_check: build a multimodal processor that checks whether to use transformers backend or native implementation
